title: 第5章 冥界大变始皇入秘境第6章 始皇立誓揽获各路大佬
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
赢鸿得意的笑道：“会的，我也相信他可以做到！”
“嘿嘿~这次我倒是要看看刘冀那小子，还怎么在我面前得瑟。”
“整天跟我吹嘘他儿子多么天才，多么天赋异禀，有大帝之姿。”
“这回，看我不把他的脸给打肿！”
始皇闻言摇头道：“没有利益的争斗，就是毫无意义的意气之争浪费时间。”
“有那些时间，你还不如多花点心思在你的修为上。”
“好歹也是一族之长，怎能只有焦热境的实力？”
赢鸿讪讪一笑：“谨遵先祖之命，赢鸿一定好好修炼，争取早日达到大焦热境。”
始皇摆了摆手说道：“行了，要是没什么事儿，你便退下吧。”
“寡人，刚从那虚无之地出来，需要些许时日来调养。”
“还需积蓄力量，在那即将来临的大世机缘之中，为这孩子谋取些许机缘。”
“若是没有什么大事，别来打搅寡人。”
始皇说完便化作一条冒着黑光的黑龙，没入小赢天体内。
好似从未没有出现过一般。
只是四周还残留着的帝王之威，彰显出了这位始皇的可怕。
赢鸿看着消失的始皇顿时一愣，随后摇头苦笑感慨道：“先祖，当真是雷厉风行啊。”
”我还想让李将军和先祖见上一面，叙叙旧呢。”
感慨一番后赢鸿先是将小赢天抱到了李玉凤怀里。
之后赢鸿便独自一人来到了书房内，眯着眼问道：“李将军，你对始皇先祖了解多少？”
片刻后赢鸿体内传出一道洪亮的声音。

“主公，此乃大不敬之罪，末将怎敢妄自非议始皇陛下。”
“请主公降罪！”
赢鸿无奈的摆了摆手道：“罢了罢了，既然你不愿说那就算了。“
”咱们都相处十几年了，我还能为难你不成？”
随后来到窗前眯着眼看着天空之上的太阳。
喃喃自语：“始皇先祖所说的机缘，到底是什么？又能否让我赢氏一族走向更高呢？”
……
三年后。
咸阳城城主府内一处较为宽广的练武场内。
一道小小的身影正挥舞着一对，重达数百斤的大铁锤。
一对铁锤在那小小的身影手中舞的虎虎生威。
每一次挥舞都会携带着一道巨大的声响。
所过之处都会掀起一阵狂风。
整整练了两个小时后，这道小小的身影才将那对与其身形极其不符的铁锤放下。
随后这道小小的身影一屁股坐在地上奶声奶气的说道：“先祖~你骗人！练锤一点都不好玩。”
“我不玩了！”
没错，这道身影正是三年前，携带着滔天异象降生的小赢天。
话音刚落一道威严的身影，瞬间出现在小赢天身后。
“小天~别胡闹，寡人让你练锤也是为了你好！”
“之后还要修炼剑术和戟法，晚上还要练习浩然正气，学习兵法韬略，政务，法律礼仪，帝王之术等课程。”

“哪有那么多时间休息，现在还不是休息的时候，赶紧起来继续练！。”
一头白发金眸可爱无比的赢天嘟着嘴说道：“我不~我就不~”
“这…”
content_en:
Yinghong smiled proudly and said: "Yes, I believe he can do it!"
"Hehe~ This time I want to see how that boy Liu Ji can be so arrogant in front of me."
"He brags to me all day long about how talented his son is, how talented he is, and how he looks like a great emperor."
"This time, let's see if I don't swell his face!"
Hearing this, the First Emperor shook his head and said: "A fight without interests is a meaningless battle of will and a waste of time."
"With all that time, you might as well spend more time on your cultivation."
"After all, he is the leader of the clan, how can he only have the strength of Jiaore Realm?"
Yinghong smiled coquettishly: "I will obey the order of my ancestors. Yinghong will practice hard and strive to reach the Great Jiao Realm as soon as possible."
The First Emperor waved his hand and said, "Okay, if nothing happens, just step back."
"I just came out of that place of nothingness and need some time to recover."
"We still need to accumulate strength and seek some opportunities for this child in the upcoming great opportunities."
"If there's nothing important, don't disturb me."
After speaking, the First Emperor turned into a black dragon with black light and sank into Xiao Yingtian's body.
It's as if it never appeared.
But the imperial power that still remained around him showed how terrifying the First Emperor was.
Yinghong was stunned when he saw the disappearing First Emperor, then shook his head with a bitter smile and sighed: "Ancestor, you are really resolute and resolute."
"I also want General Li to meet his ancestors and reminisce about old times."
After sighing with emotion, Yinghong first carried little Yingtian into Li Yufeng's arms.
After that, Yinghong came to the study alone and asked with narrowed eyes: "General Li, how much do you know about the ancestors of the First Emperor?"
After a moment, a loud voice came from Yinghong's body.
"My lord, this is a crime of great disrespect. How dare you criticize His Majesty the First Emperor?"
"Please, my lord, punish me!"
Yinghong waved his hands helplessly and said: "That's all, since you don't want to say it, forget it."
"We have been together for more than ten years, how can I still embarrass you?"
Then he came to the window and squinted at the sun in the sky.
He murmured to himself: "What exactly is the opportunity that the ancestors of the First Emperor mentioned? Can it help my Ying clan move to a higher level?"
…
Three years later.
In a relatively spacious martial arts training ground in the lord's palace of Xianyang City.
A small figure was wielding a pair of large hammers weighing hundreds of kilograms.
A pair of hammers danced like a tiger in the hands of that little figure.
Each wave carries a huge sound.
There will be a strong wind wherever it passes.
After practicing for two hours, this little figure put down the pair of hammers that were extremely inconsistent with his body shape.
Then this little figure sat down on the ground and said with a milky voice: "Ancestor, you are lying! Hammer training is not fun at all."
"I won't play anymore!"
Yes, this figure is none other than Xiao Yingtian, who was born three years ago with a monstrous vision.
As soon as he finished speaking, a majestic figure appeared behind Xiao Yingtian.
"Xiaotian~ don't be ridiculous, I let you practice hammering for your own good!"
"After that, we have to practice swordsmanship and halberd skills. In the evening, we have to practice Haoran Zhengqi, and learn the art of war, strategy, government affairs, legal etiquette, emperor's art and other courses."
"There is no time to rest. Now is not the time to rest. Get up quickly and continue practicing!"
Yingtian, who had white hair and golden eyes and was extremely cute, pouted and said, "I won't~ I won't~"
"This..."
